content: bubbletea side-by-side layout: lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, leftPane, rightPane) is the primitive. Adaptive width via tea.WindowSizeMsg updating m.width/m.height. Width split: focused pane gets wider allocation (e.g., 45 cols), unfocused narrower (24 cols), recomputed on every WindowSizeMsg and focus change. ANSI-aware truncation needed when syntax-highlighted lines exceed column width.
